Estimate how quickly an investment doubles at a fixed return. This free online rule of 72 calculator gives you an instant answer without an account, a download or sending your entries to a server. It is designed for quick everyday use on desktop and mobile. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Rule of 72 Calculator

Start by entering your annual return (%). The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause. When you want a clean slate, Reset restores the defaults. The steps below walk through each input in order.

1. Enter your annual return (%).
2. Check the result — it updates instantly as you type.
3. Use Reset to start over with the default values.

## Formula

Approximate years to double = 72 ÷ annual percentage return.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Rule of 72 Calculator](/rule-of-72-calculator) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic. If the figures look wrong, check your inputs first — a misplaced decimal point is the usual culprit.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. At 8%, the Rule of 72 estimates 9 years; exact annual compounding gives about 9.01. Try the same figures in the [Rule of 72 Calculator](/rule-of-72-calculator) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves. ## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- Check the units and labels before comparing results.
- Your entries stay in your browser and are not saved.

Keep these in mind and the figures will be as useful as the numbers you put in.

Approximate years to double = 72 ÷ annual percentage return. You can see it in action in the [Rule of 72 Calculator](/rule-of-72-calculator) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.
